name: Powerica Limited
publicShareholdingNotes: In accordance with Regulation 38 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 and Rule 19A of the Securities Contracts (Regulation) Rules, 1957, Listed companies are required to achieve a minimum public shareholding of 25% within a period of three years from the date of listing. The Company was listed on April 2, 2026.
remarksWeb: Promoter & Promoter Group - As on the date of this Shareholding Patten, Mr. Naresh Chander Oberoi is deceased. The process in relation to the transmission of all Equity Shares held by late Naresh Chander Oberoi to his successor, Ms. Renu Naresh Oberoi, is pending. Upon successful completion of such transmission, Renu Naresh Oberoi shall hold 5,11,748 Equity Shares of the Company.
